_comment: The watchlist — the single source of truth for which symbols this system
watches. Read by `toreda watchlist`, the scanner, and the dashboard.
Add or remove a symbol HERE and everything stays in sync.
Positions you actually hold are read live from your account and are ALWAYS
scanned, whether or not they appear below.
Sector names are yours to choose — they are labels for grouping and for
the scanner's sectorFocus setting, not a fixed taxonomy.
This default is a broad, liquid starting point spanning several sectors on
purpose. A watchlist of thirty names from one industry is one bet wearing
thirty tickers. See docs/building-a-watchlist.md before you tune it.
